addr: Prestige Atlanta, 80 Feet Rd, Koramangala 1A Block, Koramangala 3 Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: I visited this space with a day pass to get some work done and had a really nice experience. The workspace is incredibly spacious with plenty of room to set up comfortably. The overall vibe is great, complemented by an excellent music …

Shittiest workplace for day pass. Zero help. Wifi sucks. My wifi is not working and they are saying to wait. We will raise a ticket, their team will respond and they don't know how long it will take. Don't ever book this WeWork for day pass. Never!
If you want to work from Koramangla, this is a good place to consider. The best part of this is the open terrace garden and a big working area on the terrace.
